name: loose-ends
description: Pins the questions and tasks Claude left for you, word for word, beside the chat, without changing how Claude works

language.title: Language of the panel
language.description: Language of the panel's labels; questions always show as Claude wrote them. auto follows the language of each question or task; en or sk fixes one for everything

model.title: Model that spots questions
model.description: Alias or id of the small model that finds questions in Claude's replies

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on a new question
autoOpen.description: Docks the panel when a new question arrives, in the fullscreen layout on a wide terminal

keepDoneHours.title: Hours to keep answered questions
keepDoneHours.description: Answered and dropped questions leave the panel after this many hours, or at a release
